$comment: CC-WORDGRID E5 (signed 2026-09-18) -- the English confusion list. HAND-AUTHORED from English spelling rules, never from player data (D6). One entry is one edit: a decoy is its target with exactly ONE of these applied at ONE position. Read by tools/wordsearch/build_decoys.py (which proves each result is not a word, E6) and by src/wordsearch/confusion.rs (which re-derives every shipped decoy, I2). `at` is where the edit may apply: any, start, mid (not the first letter) or end; an optional fourth value is the shortest word it applies to. `double` doubles a consonant standing between two vowels (sepparate); `single` undoes a doubled one (adress).
